# Model sources

- Human models, fifty pet profiles, sedan, office, house, shop, bench, flowers, lamp and water surface: original procedural geometry for this Where’s My Pet? project. Authored with Three.js, exported with GLTFExporter; source: scripts/build-models.mjs.
- tree-natural.glb: Tree Small 02 by Rico Cilliers, Poly Haven. CC0 1.0. Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02 . Geometry was decimated and texture resolutions reduced for browser use. Textures and geometry are embedded in the GLB.
- Three.js runtime, GLTFLoader, GLTFExporter, BufferGeometryUtils and SkeletonUtils: MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js . Copyright notices remain in their files.

Procedural people and animal assets are detailed game models; they are not scans or a claim of photorealistic character quality.
